annotations.title: Follow next for the next passage; it carries on into the next chapter

description: Talmud Scroller. Follow next for the next passage; it carries on into the next chapter. Talmud: daily readings, plans, search and original text lookup; whole books from the Library, read a passage at a time.

book.description: Book id or title from list_books, for example pirkei-avot, bekhorot.

n.description: Passage within the section, starting at 1.

ref.description: Optional: jump straight to a passage by its reference, for example "Havamal 139", "Meditations 4.3", "Gita 2.47", "Iliad 1.5" or "10b". Overrides section and n.

section.description: Chapter, book, poem, letter or daf to start at, as listed in the book (for example 5, "chapter 2", "havamal", or 10b for the second side of a daf). Defaults to the beginning; Bekhorot defaults to today's Daf Yomi page while the cycle is in it.
